entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6107"/><title type="x-s2">PSALM 56</title> <title type="x-s3"><reference osisRef="Ps.56.1-Ps.56.13">Psa 56:1-13</reference>. Upon Jonath-elem-rechokim--literally, "upon the dove of silence" of distant places; either denoting a melody (see on <reference osisRef="Ps.9.1">Psa 9:1</reference>) of that name, to which this Psalm was to be performed; or it is an enigmatical form of denoting the subject, as given in the history referred to (<reference osisRef="1Sam.21.11">1Sa 21:11</reference>, &c.), David being regarded as an uncomplaining, meek dove, driven from his native home to wander in exile. Beset by domestic and foreign foes, David appeals confidently to God, recites his complaints, and closes with joyful and assured anticipations of God's continued help.</title> <div sID="gen9333" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6107"/><hi type="bold">1-2. would swallow--</hi>literally, "pants as a raging beast" (<reference osisRef="Acts.9.1">Ac 9:1</reference>). <div eID="gen9333" type="x-p"/>
